gates.label: Live at a public URL
gates.kill: not live in 4 weeks → cut scope in half and re-set the date; a smaller live thing beats a bigger local one

gates.label: 10 strangers used it
gates.kill: under 10 after 30 distribution actions → the pitch or the pond is wrong; revise strategy before doing 30 more

gates.label: 3 users came back unprompted
gates.kill: 50 signups and nobody returns by the goal deadline → retention problem, do not build the paid tier on top of it
